question: Rank the companies by net-income margin in 2024.
generated_sql: SELECT "company_name", ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN "metric_name" = 'net_income' THEN "metric_value" ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN "metric_name" = 'revenue' THEN "metric_value" ELSE 0 END)) * 100, 2) AS "net_income_margin_percent" FROM analytics.company_financial_metrics WHERE "fiscal_year" = 2024 AND "fiscal_period" = 'FY' AND "metric_name" IN ('net_income', 'revenue') GROUP BY "company_name" ORDER BY "net_income_margin_percent" DESC;
